# enter into the case directory
cd /global/cfs/cdirs/m5260/kuyeda/20260318.v3.SORRME3r3.CRYO2010.bluepulse-beta1-dvd.perlmutter

# modify namelist
vi user_nl_mpaso

config_am_timeseriesstatsmonthly_enable = .true.
config_use_numericalmixingtracers = .true.
config_AM_discreteVarianceDecay_enable = .true.
config_AM_discreteVarianceDecay_compute_interval = 'dt'
config_AM_discreteVarianceDecay_output_stream = 'discreteVarianceDecayOutput'
config_AM_discreteVarianceDecay_compute_on_startup = .false.
config_AM_discreteVarianceDecay_write_on_startup = .false.

# modify streams
cp run/streams.ocean SourceMods/src.mpaso/.

# Going to keep some of the other variables related to depth / layer thickness on just in case.
# Replace the output section with this

vi SourceMods/src.mpaso/streams.ocean

<stream name="output"
        type="output"
        io_type="pnetcdf,cdf5"
        filename_template="20260318.v3.SORRME3r3.CRYO2010.bluepulse-beta1-dvd.perlmutter.mpaso.hist.$Y-$M-$D_$S.nc"
        filename_interval="00-01-00_00:00:00"
        clobber_mode="truncate"
        reference_time="01-01-01_00:00:00"
        output_interval="00-01-00_00:00:00">

    <var name="layerThickness"/>
    <var name="refZMid"/>
    <var name="refLayerThickness"/>
    <var name="xtime"/>
    <var name="displacedDensity"/>
    <var name="potentialDensity"/>
    <var name="density"/>
    <var name="refBottomDepth"/>
    <var name="zMid"/>
</stream>
